newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes shortfall may spill into '97.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes shortfall may spill into '97.

text.p: Great Lakes Chemical Corp's expected earnings shortfall may go beyond the third quarter and full year, analysts said Wednesday.
The company said it sees earnings for the quarter and year below street estimates and below 1995 results. It earned $1.15 in the year-ago third quarter and $4.52 for the full year.

"Because of weak demand, the company is stuck with overcapacity and a lot of extra expenses," said Merrill Lynch analyst Robert Hardiman. He was reviewing his $4.55 per share estimate for 1996 and said his 1997 estimate of $5 would likely come down as well.
Prior to Great Lakes' revised outlook, the First Call consensus estimates were at $1.21 for the quarter and $4.60 for the full year.
Great Lakes, a specialty chemical producer, cited weakness in the polymer industry, especially in Europe and the Far East.
Its stock was trading at 54-7/8, off 2-1/8.
